messages:
Priya Patel: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Opening this follow-up for process Qs we ran out of time on: release cadence, oncall, quality bars, SLAs. Drop short Qs and we'll answer during the live Q&A.

Alex Chen: Are we sticking to weekly release trains for hosted APIs? a few slipped recently.

Priya Patel: Weekly is still the target for hosted. Recent slips were due to infra migrations and an emergency rollback. We'll document an exceptions policy and communication timeline.

Samir Gupta: Canary duration and rollback thresholds? do runtime-impacting PRs require the full perf suite pre-merge?

Priya Patel: Default canary is 30m. Rollback if error-rate >0.5% over baseline or p95 latency +15% sustained for 5m. Runtime-impacting PRs require smoke perf checks pre-merge; full perf suite runs post-merge and can block broader promotions. Use the "perf-test" PR label for special runners.

Marta Lopez: Oncall: any plan to move infra to 2-week rotations? 1-week is burning people out.

Priya Patel: We'll pilot 2-week rotations for infra next quarter. Runtime oncall remains 1-week for now. Coverage model: runtime = 1 primary + 1 secondary; infra = 1 primary + 2 secondaries. Rota template and shadow plan coming.

Alex Chen: Will the Releases UI show per-route canary health (p50/p95/error-rate)?

Priya Patel: Yes, Releases will show route-level p50/p95 and error-rate plus a canary health badge. Alex, please mock the UI and link it in the follow-up doc.

Samir Gupta: SLA tiers: hosted public SLA still 99.9? Dedicated higher tiers?

Priya Patel: Public hosted SLA target remains 99.9. Dedicated customers can opt into 99.95 with reserved capacity and contractual terms. We'll publish an SLA tier matrix with examples.

Priya Patel: Action items: I'll write a one-pager with thresholds and examples. Marta to draft hosted vs dedicated release differences. Alex to mock console canary UI. Post PRs to #eng-docs and we'll iterate.

Marta Lopez: I'll open the draft PR by EOD tomorrow.

Alex Chen: Will share a Figma mock later today.
